scenario: Sign-in/check/setup/login with no bearer session; disabled account; invalid PIN; already-set PIN
required_result: Existing public identity entry remains usable with its existing checks/rate limits; disabled account and invalid/setup conflicts rejected; no Admin credential copy.

scenario: Account with Teacher plus scoped Admin opens Learn and learner preview
required_result: Learner projection excludes Admin source and staff-only assessment duration/maximum, including nested errors/preview/export fields.

scenario: Same account opens Teach then explicitly enters Admin
required_result: Teach returns accepted inputs and permitted staff fields; only explicit authorised Admin request loads editors/private source; current screens retained.

scenario: Program Admin attempts another Program/Course; mixed-scope batch contains one forbidden entry
required_result: Out-of-scope access denied and entire mutation batch unchanged; no newly broadened User/Teacher designation permission.

scenario: Global Admin has no explicit scoped role in selected Program/Course
required_result: Existing Global Admin inheritance retained on every applicable Admin action; learner projection still does not turn into Admin data.

scenario: Remove own Global Admin, reset own PIN, or concurrently remove last two active Global Admins
required_result: Existing own-change restrictions remain; resulting Core state always retains one active Global Admin under concurrent changes.

scenario: Valid legacy PIN requires hash upgrade while another session has a remote admission
required_result: Credential epoch transition preserves existing invalidation semantics and the durable ordering of outstanding work; no lost decision or copied Admin hash.

scenario: Teacher designation removed but independent scoped teaching assignment remains
required_result: Only designation-dependent features change; no blanket all-scope grant on designation creation and no unintended removal of independent assignment.

scenario: Client spoofs workspace, contributor/submitter ID, account query or Global Admin role
required_result: Server derives actor and validates requested action/context; supplied labels/IDs cannot grant authority or falsify attribution.

scenario: Cross-area kind/ID/run/class/session mismatch and unknown request fields
required_result: Reject before business mutation; do not infer another selected area, drop unexpected effects silently, or fall back to Admin source.

scenario: Admin saves subject/module names and schedule changes without publishing
required_result: Current Learn/Teach remain on accepted definitions; source edits accumulate for one reviewed batch.

scenario: Shared name change affects several timetables including a scope publisher cannot administer
required_result: Full dependency set identified; publication blocked or explicitly authorised for all affected scopes; no partial rename on reader schedules.

scenario: Freeze, then edit source rows or substitute a different component hash
required_result: Frozen bytes/revisions remain exact; changed source requires a different reviewed batch; hash/schema/count/reference mismatch cannot seal/activate.

scenario: One required component or its target is unavailable
required_result: Existing accepted head remains; response is pending/unavailable, never successful partial publication or a query to private drafts.

scenario: Two publishers accept against the same expected head; retry winner after lost response
required_result: At most one head transition from that revision; loser gets safe conflict; retry returns original operation result with no duplicate grants/components.

scenario: Reader requests related timetable, curriculum, assessment and PDF metadata while a head advances
required_result: Related reads bind one accepted vector; current access/file policy still checked; no mixed source revision or unapproved maximum/duration.

scenario: Current cancellation, account removal or run completion races acceptance of an older content batch
required_result: Current policy/lifecycle dominates; activation cannot resurrect suppressed access or overwrite live work.

scenario: Program/Course publish creates missing Teacher role; Admin later revokes it; old publish is retried
required_result: Original receipt recovery only; no recreated role. A genuinely new grant requires a new explicit authorised effect and current revision.

scenario: Copied Program/Course includes learners/teachers; repeated Course; draft Stage DRAFT
required_result: New identities and existing draft-access gate preserved; repeat does not copy students automatically; no operational attendance copied.

scenario: Current Course details_json contains draft schedule/fees/teacher/link/stage; published reader is requested
required_result: Reader uses accepted projected fields and separate current Core stage/run policy; private JSON is never fallback. PUBLISHED to DRAFT retains existing publication.

scenario: Account disable/PIN reset/logout/role removal arrives before a protected new request
required_result: Affected new access/admissions blocked immediately at Core closure; response cannot rely on a cached grant or session snapshot.

scenario: Remote Admin write was admitted before role revocation starts and later commits
required_result: Destination decision APPLIED, business write and receipt agree; revocation completes only after terminal verification. UI may show pending until resolved.

scenario: Remote write admitted before revocation is delayed; no receipt found yet
required_result: Cancellation is terminally fenced at destination or APPLIED is verified; missing receipt alone never proves it cannot commit later.

scenario: Destination down, Worker restarted or initiating session expires during closure
required_result: Affected new access stays blocked; unresolved operation/closure remains durable and pending; no timeout-based release or fake completion.

scenario: Authority granted through multiple independent valid paths; remove one path
required_result: Dependency set is conservative and checked atomically; remaining valid authority is preserved. Do not equate one role deletion with whole-account disable.

scenario: Revoker loses own authority while its pending authority change is being finalised
required_result: Final effect rechecks initiator authority; pending state reconciles safely without resurrecting removed access or reporting false success.

scenario: PAID Course Student subscription removed while Teacher/Admin role remains; imported Student evidence still exists
required_result: Explicit subscription decision overrides imported Student access; unrelated valid staff access preserved; FREE Course per-account change rejected.

scenario: Dated membership/class assignment changes while a register or note contribution is being accepted
required_result: Exact current scope checked at commit; stale operation rejected without partial business effects; accepted historical roster evidence stays immutable.

scenario: Wrong actor, changed payload or alternate route reuses an operation ID; terminal retry after permission loss
required_result: Original identity/hash/namespace/owner enforced; no second application. Only minimal owned outcome may return after access loss, without protected records/files. Minimal owned status verifies a still-valid identity session independently of workspace grant; invalid identity sessions remain rejected.

scenario: Writer bypass through legacy dispatcher, multipart upload, maintenance tool or recovery job
required_result: All effective writers use the same owner/generation and admission/commit guard; retired/unmapped writer cannot apply a business mutation.

scenario: PAPER upload supplies changed duration/maximum, attempts role/release fields, or examiner assignment races
required_result: Narrow candidate definition goes to Admin; unsupported effects rejected; current examiner permission and accepted definition/file binding remain enforced.

scenario: Learner and dual-role Learn read assessment JSON, learner preview, standard/custom-background report PDF, script/paper bytes, metadata, conflict/replay and legacy download
required_result: Omit duration/maximum and revealing denominators from learner JSON and official file bytes, including standard report maximum column/out-of total and embedded custom background. Explicit Learn projection selects reviewed immutable learner file binding, never staff original by highest role. No inline marks/percentages in learner tables or their response; released reports show achieved marks only, with no maxima. The expressly requested countdown can show remaining time without a configured duration field. Exact hash/source/template binding required; no caller safe flag.

scenario: Each of five assessment file kinds uploaded/read under learner, examiner, moderator and Admin contexts
required_result: Preserve each file kind current validator and exact release/owner/class/examiner/reviewer rights; no generic staff endpoint widens Teacher access. Own original ANSWER bytes unchanged. Safe shared bytes or reviewed learner copy for official files. Setup publication and uploaded/staged bytes release no paper/results; no extra role or approval stage.

scenario: Assessment redefinition/deletion/recipient changes after submission, marking or result release; Academy timezone changes versus effective paper opening, status validation, answer acceptance and report issue date
required_result: Stable accepted-version/history links retained; current gate applied; no reset of released marks or silent deletion of operational history. New schedules resolve existing 03:00 convention under central Academy timezone; all availability/started/completion consumers use captured opens_at. Preserve effective/historical instants on config change and existing schedule lifecycle gates.

scenario: Teacher posts valid PDF; staged upload fails or current materials unreleased
required_result: Only exact owned validated candidate can post; failed staging leaves accepted data intact; successful unreleased post awaits release rather than granting visibility.

scenario: Teacher replaces/withdraws own verified note versus another Teacher/Admin-managed/unknown-provenance note; Admin takes control and a stale Teacher replacement retries
required_result: Only current eligible verified contributor with contributor control can replace/withdraw. Admin can take control within scope; current version/policy guard rejects a stale Teacher write. Retain unknown provenance as Admin-managed; no automatic physical deletion.
policy_basis: Confirmed 21 October 2026: own-note changes; Admin can take control

scenario: Teacher calls old general media save, attachment-remove, create recording or discussion endpoint
required_result: Broad curation no longer available to Teacher; retired discussion cannot post; narrow authorised PDF contribution remains. Admin keeps current scoped curation.

scenario: PDF limit/hash/content mismatch, foreign/expired candidate, concurrent final attachment slots; binary stored then Core acceptance/receipt recovery is unavailable
required_result: Retain current per-PDF/attachment limits and signatures; target acceptance verifies hash/owner/count/current revisions; no half-posted attachment. Unknown Core outcome keeps the candidate; no error/timer/session-expiry cleanup deletes possibly accepted bytes. Original terminal fenced outcome and current unreferenced-owner proof precede cleanup eligibility; no cleanup executed here.

scenario: Teacher uses old official metadata/cover/taxonomy editor or selected Program library entry
required_result: Official writes require Admin through actual coordinator/R2 writer; teacher reader retains current permitted Public/Program catalogue access and context.

scenario: Another teacher/admin guesses private My links IDs; old PDF uses library=personal; private Academy media unavailable
required_result: Personal collection remains own-user and separate from official catalogue/Academy D1. Legacy PDF returns as before; unimplemented private media remains unavailable.

scenario: Explicit first submit has zero absent learners for one eligible session
required_result: Create register and unique Program/Course day evidence; no Present/Excused rows; record actual authenticated submitter, not assigned Teacher.

scenario: No register submitted, eligible roster missing, or no eligible denominator days
required_result: Show pending coverage or percentage unavailable as applicable; never infer full attendance from a missing register or divide by zero.

scenario: Four required sessions: learner absent from one; all required registers recorded
required_result: One date in denominator and 0.75 day in numerator; absent only records plus shared roster/register/day evidence.

scenario: Correct existing register, retry same submit, or another Teacher corrects with stale revision
required_result: Latest accepted correction only; no duplicate date/series/register effects and stale revision rejected; submitter recorded for each accepted version.

scenario: All lessons shows Mixed; user leaves a value untouched, edits another and explicitly confirms new first target
required_result: Preserve each existing per-session base set; do not distribute aggregate absence set to every lesson or silently turn missing registers into attended.

scenario: One explicit batch target is stale, forbidden, duplicate, wrong date/roster or has a non-roster absentee
required_result: All listed targets fail atomically without new registers/day/receipt effects; actionable error retains client edits; any advisory UI aggregate never becomes a stored status.

scenario: Admin assigns a substitute to exactly one dated session/group; submitter sends assigned Teacher ID; substitute has no other workspace context
required_result: Only selected link/attendance capability is granted; server records actual substitute as submitter; no permanent role or library entitlement. Active grant supplies a restricted Teach context for sign-in/PIN setup/context switching; no unrestricted Teacher claim, legacy API bypass or permanent role is used to make access work.

scenario: Substitute replaced/revoked or link/first-submit/correction deadline reached with stale page open
required_result: Enforce substitute FIRST from start/activation until session-day midnight; existing-register corrections until following-day midnight; scoped Admin may reopen corrections up to 24 elapsed hours. Recheck assignment/current time/revision, including restricted context for reopened corrections. Expired FIRST cannot be revived by correction reopening; independent ordinary authority remains valid.
policy_basis: Confirmed 21 October 2026: substitute windows and correction-only reopening

scenario: Ordinary authorised Teacher/Admin FIRST for a past session, including zero absences, older dates, unreliable dated roster, future date, expired substitute-only grant and simultaneous first writers
required_result: Past date alone is not a refusal: ordinary current authority plus reliable dated roster permits normal FIRST, without late permit/named recorder/reason/24-hour ordinary-first window. Future FIRST, missing reliable evidence, wrong scope/lifecycle and expired substitute FIRST still fail. Unique first register/day evidence and actual submitter are atomic; no duplicate denominator.
policy_basis: Confirmed 21 October 2026: remove blanket past-date FIRST block; keep approved substitute deadlines

scenario: Membership transfer or timetable republication after attendance acceptance; cancelled/replaced occurrence
required_result: Accepted roster/day evidence retained; explicit identity/lifecycle policy handles changed occurrences; no duplicate denominator or silent rewrite from current roster. For a missing past register derive a reliable dated roster rather than an empty historical-read shortcut or today’s list.

scenario: Run saved-link families L01-L24 under signed-out, learner, Teacher, scoped/Global and dual-role fixtures
required_result: Old Admin navigation opens only authorised new workspace; API aliases enforce current policy; readers never bootstrap old editors or fetch Admin draft fallback.

scenario: Embedded template fetch and direct navigation both use an old management URL
required_result: Distinguish component fetch from navigation redirect; preserve existing tab/context; no sign-in loop, editor double mount or accidental save.

scenario: Program/Course Admin tabs at wide/mobile widths
required_result: Current V107.9 ordering retained: Review & publish then Lesson media/Media then Enrolment requests; keyboard/selection/form/responsive behaviour preserved.

scenario: Validation issue opens lesson while Program Review tab is visible and draft is dirty
required_result: V107.8 openTab timetable handoff keeps draft, makes editor visible and preserves cancel/save/revalidate; no hidden blocking modal.

scenario: Teacher chooses Program then opens Library/PDF and returns; explicit Hifz handoff
required_result: Current Teacher Program first, actual Program-name/Public/Academy labels, context-preserving return and current PDF controls remain; no new navigation redesign.

scenario: Switch account/context during slow component load or protected file request
required_result: Discard stale component/data callbacks and recheck current session; no former account roster, Admin editor, private link or stale action appears.

scenario: Authorised future development attendance reset then old-format writer or pre-reset operation retries
required_result: No legacy attendance import required; new reset/writer generation fences application of old payloads. Preserve only permitted minimal outcomes, never recreate removed attendance.

scenario: Old import/activation/repair process or cache/Hifz job runs after boundary cutover
required_result: Old writer blocked or explicitly adapted to actual owner; no old role/credential restoration; Hifz privileged data never routed through Admin publication.

scenario: Largest supported publication, attendance batch and profile batch with all guards/index/receipt writes
required_result: Measure worst-case local atomic batch and reads/writes including retry/closure overhead. Enforce reviewed bounds without partial attendance or multiple independent live heads.

scenario: Interrupted cutover/rollback with in-flight remote admission, accepted publication or new-format attendance
required_result: Resume from durable original-owner outcomes; compatible generation only. No rollback to unfenced old writer, private-draft reader, second head or credential copy.

scenario: V107.14 timetable edit/resume immediately before Save draft on Weekly planning board and in Review & publish; dirty/saved/imported drafts on desktop and phone
required_result: Retain both current edit actions and explanation, with edit/resume immediately before board Save draft. Shared locked/ready/conflict/dirty guards remain; saved/working draft wins over copying published state. Accepted timetable unchanged until reviewed publish; pending recovery and desktop/phone placement preserved. Preserve V107.16 Program Review & publish edit/discard row and planning-board discard-before-edit/resume, current unsaved/save/conflict disable rules, cancellation, saved draft/published snapshots and desktop/mobile placement.
policy_basis: Current committed V107.14 layout/behaviour preservation; V107.10 draft-first behaviour retained

scenario: Scoped Course participant-create, Global Admin request registration, duplicated retry and failed request binding
required_result: Preserve distinct existing authorities; exactly one Core account/credential/Student/subscription set or none. Enrolment request alone grants nothing, and no credential or login-link secret enters Admin publication.

scenario: Teacher tries self-availability edit through old API; Admin changes calendar/availability after validation but before publish
required_result: Teacher write is closed as directed; authorised Admin source edit invalidates relevant validation, without silently replacing accepted timetable or unrelated live authority.

scenario: Admin edits/imports a memorisation module/set and task; learner/Teacher reads before and after publication
required_result: Only authorised setup editor changes source; Learn/Teach use accepted version, stable task IDs and existing progress/confirmation history. memorisation_tasks.module_id still references its set, not curriculum modules.

scenario: Learner marks self, spoofs another learner; assigned/unassigned Teacher confirms; Global Admin disables card/area then stale mark retries
required_result: Preserve own-marking and current assigned confirmation rules; current disable blocks new work immediately without content publication. Retry has only original terminal outcome; it cannot re-enable policy or overwrite another learner.

scenario: Feature/policy settings and enrolment catalogue or announcement/planning source changed while an old batch is pending
required_result: Classify actual per-key gate; current close/disable decision remains effective. Source catalogue/request/text changes confer no role, no premature content activation and no reopening from stale snapshot/recovery.

scenario: Admin changes class module progress; Teacher attempts the same through old management path; learner memorisation has existing progress
required_result: Admin source change appears only through reviewed accepted input; Teacher has no class-module setup write. Learner task completion/Teacher confirmation remain separate Core work with unchanged action permissions.

scenario: V107.11 period start/end retiming across weekdays/classes, spanning lessons, aligned/independent breaks, whole-change Undo and immediate clash hints
required_result: Preserve stable lesson identities, draft retiming and whole-change Undo; preserve independent gap breaks and current clash hints; keep server validation/publication checks. Saving draft changes never mutates accepted timetable; extraction loads periods helper before planner.
policy_basis: Current committed V107.11 draft and publication behaviour preservation

scenario: V107.12 subject-column Library editor, alphabetical/Uncategorised ordering, search, dirty-state navigation, phone controls and cached Archive volume labels
required_result: Preserve settled editor/search/unsaved-state/mobile behaviour when moving Admin. Keep resource/file identities and real combined-part labels; repair duplicate cached labels without forced network fetch or widening catalogue permissions.

scenario: V107.13 PDF Whiteboard alongside selected split PDF, drawing/notes/history/resize/download controls, close/return and unsaved tab state; V107.15 PDF controls above their own document panes
required_result: Preserve current Whiteboard/reader controls and PDF frame/page/split behaviour. Whiteboard drawings/notes remain current-reader-tab work and explicit local export/share, distinct from official session PDF notes; no new Academy D1, catalogue or Admin publication write is introduced by reader extraction. Preserve V107.15 PDF control placement above the corresponding document pane, split/full-screen/mobile behaviour and independent document state; no unrelated reader redesign.
policy_basis: Preserve current committed V107.13 behaviour; design-only review

scenario: Delivery roster prefill with explicit Course learners, Free/public access, Teacher/Admin-only participants, repeat run and changed prefill evidence
required_result: Admin reviews dated learners separately for each run. Prefill performs no write or role/content grant; excludes merely implicit public access or staff-only entries. Current scoped/Global Admin can save; Teacher/substitute cannot manage roster. Changed evidence refreshes review.
policy_basis: Confirmed 21 October 2026: Admin-managed roster per delivery, prefilled from Course participants

scenario: Inclusive join/leave, later rejoin, interval void/correction, inactive historical learner anchor, missing past FIRST and already sealed register
required_result: Non-overlapping VALID intervals preserve original dated eligibility; leaving does not erase the past. Missing past FIRST uses reliable evidence under ordinary authority and approved substitute limits. Accepted roster/denominator never silently rewrites; explicit reconciliation identifies affected contexts. Combined Course/date counts once across relevant runs.
policy_basis: Confirmed delivery-roster/past-FIRST/proportional-day rules; exact interval schema proposed

scenario: Two Admin roster saves from one revision, duplicate operation, malformed interval and cross-run account/anchor selection
required_result: At most one conflicting roster save accepts. Expected roster/row/prefill revisions, inclusive date order and no overlapping VALID interval are checked with atomic local enrolment/audit/retry acceptance. No partial batch, cross-run change, caller-selected actor or content/role side effect.
policy_basis: Confirmed roster model; proposed local command/constraint design

scenario: Two devices add/edit/remove/reorder own links from the same collection revision, including storage-only bookkeeping etag changes
required_result: Conditional envelope update accepts business changes plus terminal decision together. Conflicting user revisions retain local edits and require deliberate refresh/retry; removed items cannot be silently restored. A bookkeeping-only conflict may retry after unchanged user revision and current eligibility are verified.
policy_basis: Agreed private own-user links; proposed conditional R2 contract

scenario: Private save loses acknowledgement; negative read, duplicate retry, 429/outage, account/session closure and cancellation race
required_result: Unknown outcome stays pending until verified APPLIED or a same-key terminal cancellation fence. Missing object/decision does not prove failure. Core closure stops new reads/admissions and completes only after old operations settle; retry neither applies twice nor restores eligibility. No private content in minimal owned status.
policy_basis: Existing permission-finality design applied to proposed private R2 destination

scenario: Teacher/Admin with no scoped workspace, substitute-only account, loss of all Teacher/Admin roles, disabled account and forged target owner
required_result: Current active identity and restricted own-library context, without a fabricated broad Course role. Current Teacher/Admin eligibility permits first creation; after a successful creation the active owner keeps view/edit/add/remove/export access after role loss, even when the established collection is empty. Failed/cancelled creation gives no ownership; settle an admitted first-save/role-removal race. Substitute-only status adds no library rights. Disabled identity and forged other owner denied; no wider Course/media grant.
policy_basis: Confirmed 21 October 2026: keep existing personal links with own editing/export while account active; first creation remains Teacher/Admin-only

scenario: Own Drive/Archive/cloud URL with private query token, Public + My links union, legacy library=personal and current public PDF bookmark route
required_result: Open valid external source with provider permission; no server fetch/credential ingestion or official proxy expansion. Personal URL/title/tags/positions stay out of Academy D1, public catalogue, shared caches/logs and publications. Old For-you/PDF bookmarks keep existing meaning; own edit cannot affect official entries or another owner.
policy_basis: Agreed official/personal separation and preserved current routes

scenario: Remove all items, epoch compaction, delayed old request, cancellation-only envelope and late response after account switch
required_result: Retain destination rejection floor/terminal identity before compacting decisions; no delete/recreate resurrects an old write. Cancellation-only state grants no ACTIVE collection entitlement. Empty own collection remains isolated. Sign-out/account change clears display and rejects old pending response; no private work appears under the next account.
policy_basis: Proposed private-store epoch/retry/privacy design; no cleanup executed

scenario: Published exam tables, final exam day, hidden marking table and manual later exception across two Imtihaans
required_result: Own published Date/Subject home schedule and requested exam columns, no configured duration/inline marks. Never hide another active exam or valid released report. Final-day 03:00 stage shortcut cannot suppress an open sitting. After exam day, status/recovery/report only; no later-day upload/late-sitting/replacement row. A proposed hidden-table same-day control requires current open-day recipient/submission authority; Ready availability is a separate all-uploaded-and-checked-or-next-day guard, not a condition for uploading. Reports show achieved marks only.
policy_basis: Confirmed 21 October: learner late upload on exam day only; later exceptions Admin-manual; earlier sitting/15-minute allowance/achieved-only reports retained. Ready availability is confirmed as all expected submissions uploaded AND checked OR next Academy day; direct Admin handling uses ordinary records. Fixed-day exam context; assignment-specific timing/calendar/late rules are A101–A106.

scenario: First access, 15-minute/custom allowance, two devices, countdown zero, midnight cutoff and allowance change
required_result: Capture original real first access plus writing/allowance snapshots and effective deadline. 120 minutes at 09:00 plus 15 ends 11:15. Reload/retry never resets; changed default leaves started attempt unchanged. Zero permits otherwise valid same-exam-day upload, binds actual acceptance time/Late with no penalty. Allowance cannot extend exclusive exam-day cutoff, even if timer crosses midnight. An APPLIED retry returns its original time/outcome.
policy_basis: Confirmed 21 October: learner late upload on exam day only; later exceptions Admin-manual; earlier sitting/15-minute allowance/achieved-only reports retained. Ready availability is confirmed as all expected submissions uploaded AND checked OR next Academy day; direct Admin handling uses ordinary records. Fixed-day exam context; assignment-specific timing/calendar/late rules are A101–A106.

scenario: Direct earlier-date/allowance adjustments and later-day learner attempt
required_result: Current scoped/Global Admin can directly adjust exact earlier recipient date/allowance with ordinary revisions/history. Preserve original access; no timer reset or later-day learner exam reopening. Classmates unchanged. No special grant/revoke workflow. Later handling is manual Admin work.
policy_basis: Final user direction: direct Admin access, manual acceptance/remarking/release, no systems around edge cases; ordinary permission/source/history retained

scenario: Lost upload acknowledgement, latest replacement and post-cutoff recovery
required_result: Uploaded requires an accepted exact file/submission. Same operation recovers original result; staff confirms actual latest PDF. Ordinary replacement preserves history and does not inherit old check/mark. After exam day learner has own status/recovery/report only. Admin later upload uses ordinary controls with real actor/correct learner; Ready uses final manual rule, with no case/readiness isolation engine.
policy_basis: Final user direction: direct Admin access, manual acceptance/remarking/release, no systems around edge cases; ordinary permission/source/history retained

scenario: Normal/earlier Academy exam date, midnight boundary, transfer started before cutoff but accepted later, device clock and changed timezone
required_result: Acceptance at cutoff is outside exam day; browser date/request start/staging is insufficient. Same-day after timer may be Late; timer/allowance cannot extend date. APPLIED pre-cutoff retry returns original result after cutoff; unknown operation is recovered without creating a fresh after-cutoff submission. Capture accepted Academy timezone/UTC decision time; historical accepted times remain.
policy_basis: Confirmed day limit; exclusive midnight and final acceptance predicate are technical design Fixed-day exam context; assignment-specific timing/calendar/late rules are A101–A106.

scenario: Direct Admin first answer/replacement, target scope and lost acknowledgement
required_result: Scoped/Global Admin in Admin uploads/replaces through ordinary assessment upload for exact learner; learner/Teacher/preview/wrong-scope target denied. Learner owns answer, Admin is actual uploader; no fabricated learner access. Retain original files/history, current revisions and exact retry recovery. No case entity or dedicated manual-file workflow.
policy_basis: Final user direction: direct Admin access, manual acceptance/remarking/release, no systems around edge cases; ordinary permission/source/history retained

scenario: Direct Admin mark/revise/finalise and explicit release
required_result: Admin records/revises ordinary marking for intended learner, optional exact marked PDF, deliberately finalises and separately releases. Same Admin may finalise then release without second moderator; normal examiner self-moderation remains. Valid zero is not Pending. Upload/save alone never releases, no private notes/maxima in learner output and no accidental class/category release. No supplemental/manual-result subsystem.
policy_basis: Final user direction: direct Admin access, manual acceptance/remarking/release, no systems around edge cases; ordinary permission/source/history retained

scenario: Distinct Checked status; manual Ready with partial uploads, all uploaded but unchecked, all uploaded and checked, next day, warning Cancel/Continue and concurrent change
required_result: Waiting -> Uploaded -> Checked -> manually set Ready for assessment -> Assessed -> Moderated -> Marks released. Checked is derived from actual received latest-PDF confirmations; show expected/received/checked counts without treating missing as checked. Before next day, Ready action is unavailable if any expected answer is missing OR unchecked; all expected answers uploaded AND checked enables manual selection but never auto-sets Ready. From next Academy day Ready can be selected despite incomplete uploads/checking. If unchecked received papers remain, warn Admin with current count and offer Cancel / Continue anyway. Cancel changes no Ready state; explicit Continue sets Ready without auto-checking papers, filling missing answers or releasing results. Same-day unavailability cannot be bypassed by the warning. Bind warning acknowledgement to exact current unchecked set/revision; racing upload/replacement/check forces re-evaluation, not stale acceptance. Recover committed retry without another transition. Later answers remain Admin-manual; existing scope/examiner/release/source rules remain. User-approved manual edge case: next-day Admin can set Ready with zero uploads and receive manual submissions later; show Ready/zero received without fake Checked, marks or release. Admin override remains in Admin; the same account sees only student/Teacher controls in Learn/Teach.
policy_basis: User confirmed: distinct Checked stage; manual Ready enabled after all uploaded AND checked OR next day; unchecked-paper warning with Cancel / Continue; no implementation. Fixed-day exam context; assignment-specific timing/calendar/late rules are A101–A106.

scenario: Zero-upload next-day manual Ready, partial checked collection, returned marking and current source counts
required_result: Before next day, partial or unchecked expected collection cannot enable Ready. From next day Admin can manually set Ready with zero uploads and add manual answers later. Display Ready with real zero/missing counts; never auto-derive Checked/Assessed/Moderated/Marks released from empty equality. Partial checked received set keeps expected/missing counts distinct. Current marking/moderation/release stages require non-zero current work; returned marking and pending replacement stay visible with history. No fabricated receipt or result.
policy_basis: Confirmed zero-upload manual exception and normal Checked/manual Ready sequence; count/status reducer details proposed Fixed-day exam context; assignment-specific timing/calendar/late rules are A101–A106.

scenario: Read-only offer, Cancel, Continue, changing unchecked set, lost acknowledgement, old client and revoked Admin
required_result: Existing read returns current offer without Ready mutation or completed write receipt. Cancel sends no write. Final Admin Continue binds current unchecked set and revisions; changed set/authority requires refreshed review and cannot be silently acknowledged. Final write identity is created for decision; identical unknown commit recovers original before a new logical action. Legacy client cannot default override; same-day unavailability is not bypassed. Valid next-day unchecked/empty Ready survives old UI/API/register guards; no automatic PDF check/mark/release.
policy_basis: Confirmed warning/Cancel/Continue; exact read-offer/retry contract is technical design Fixed-day exam context; assignment-specific timing/calendar/late rules are A101–A106.

scenario: Ordinary replacement and direct Admin handling after Ready/release
required_result: Ordinary learner replacement retains open exam-day/assignment permission and normal current-source checks/history. New answer inherits no old PDF check/mark. Returned ordinary marking requires examiner correction/moderation. Admin manually handles late first/replacement and already released work using ordinary answer/mark/release controls. Preserve true counts and original history. No automated hold/reinstatement, per-case readiness or release correction workflow.
policy_basis: Final user direction: direct Admin access, manual acceptance/remarking/release, no systems around edge cases; ordinary permission/source/history retained

scenario: Imtihaan tracking save/validate, automatic stage, no-answer paper and direct legacy Ready/mark/release call
required_result: Register tracking never sets paper Ready or warning acknowledgement. Current accepted zero-upload/unchecked next-day Ready is represented without hidden all-checked/received guard undoing it; no empty-set assessed/moderated/released/completed claim. Old clients and templates enforce same confirmed Ready gate/acknowledgement. Final-day sitting is not hidden by old 03:00 completion shortcut. No alias grants later learner upload or implicit release.
policy_basis: Confirmed Ready/manual edge and existing explicit release boundary; aggregate adapters proposed Fixed-day exam context; assignment-specific timing/calendar/late rules are A101–A106.

scenario: Scoped/Global/dual-role Admin opens every Learn and Teach feature in published/unpublished/released contexts

Preserve ordinary permitted older/permanent recordings and exact current access.
